Context memory system: graph.json index plus decisions (each with a reversal condition), measurements (n/method/date), rejected and architecture files, validated in both directions by context.mjs --check in CI

Prompt compiler (CORE/TAIL): Single compile() for every lane: byte-stable cacheable CORE plus budgeted TAIL slots with whole-block drop order, rules that must fire appended last (shapelint-enforced), and hashCore/byte-identity fixtures that protect the prefix cache

AgentModule persona registry: Persona as an injected module or CharacterSheet; a second agent is a registry row (Kabir passes 412/412 invariants)

Honesty output gate: Predicate on output bytes: an identifier not present in the input counts as invented (provenance allowlist that keeps helplines by mechanism), plus receipt and presupposition detectors and content-preservation controls
Surface adapter contract: Channels implement verify/parse/send/render only; identity, recall, compile, gate and logging are shared; a single fail-closed gatedReply site is asserted structurally
Person x Agent x Surface tenancy: Relationship keyed by (agent_id, person_id); vy_surface_identity has no agent_id; agent-scope WHERE predicate applied before ranking
Structural disclosure: Privacy as a SQL WHERE clause over episode participants, with withdraw-not-delete; 0 leaks in 31,122 checks
Upstream failure ladder: One classifier (quota / deterministic / transient), same-key retry, wall-clock deadline, family cooling and a two-phase fuse; driven by a fake-clock eval
Azure OpenAI v1 lane: Azure Foundry chat/vision last-resort lane with deployment defaults; skips cleanly when unconfigured; embeddings helper
Turn trace: Seven-leg per-turn spine plus append-only legs; client is the only writer; converging upserts; stores references and hashes, never content; zero added SQL on the reply path

Episodic memory and consolidation: Episodes as citation ground truth, index-only citations, 5% second-family entailment audit that halts the run, contradictions as new rows, hard-delete forget with suppression, nightly finalize
Semantic recall on Neon: halfvec(1536) person-filtered exact scan (40ms p50) run concurrently with keyword recall
Client-side voice floor: Hold ring, echo coefficient, LISTEN/BARGE bars, silence heartbeat, stuck-endpoint watchdog, goAway rotation; the client owns barge-in decisions
Echosim audio-floor simulator: Transpiles the real liveCall.ts standalone and drives it through a room impulse response; 80-call floor table plus stucksim and rotatesim
Voice identity guard and spoken-text sanitiser: Asserts every lane names the same voice and model; sanitiser with mustSay content-preservation tests
Lifecycle matrix as code: Events x contexts grid where each cell names its carrier and a reason; a declared-but-dead direct cell fails the build
verify-release and workflow lint: One command runs all gates and prints failures together; --live probes are opt-in; lints illegal contexts in job-level if:; CI config stub

html-portfolio [claude/ai-companion-app-rkt1lv, claude/zen-keller-dydb02, codex/meera-forget-integrity-oct09]: The newest Meera/Maya companion line: about 38 commits on top of main (which already holds the world layer, the RelationalOS split and the resilience ladder). It adds the 2026-08-25 hardening wave, the Oct-04 password gate and forget-requires-asking incident fixes, plus two lines that diverge: a partial-forget episode-integrity fix (codex branch) and maya.vyakti.ai preview tags (claude branches).

Upstream failure ladder + lane order: A single classifier sorts upstream failures into quota, transient, deterministic or empty_200. Transient failures get a same-key retry with jittered backoff and a hard wall-clock deadline. Lane order lives in visible constants, and with the flag off the original frozen array is returned by identity.

Explicit prompt-cache manager: Explicit Google cachedContents keyed by a SHA-256 of the core bytes. TTL acts as garbage collection, refreshes are rate-limited, and a dead cache name is recreated before falling back to an uncached call. Live-verified at -77%.

Internals disclosure fence: A deterministic output predicate for three severe disclosure shapes: confirmation, volunteered vendor name, and architecture claim. It allows one re-draft and has documented cases where it must not fire. Offline: 2/2 severe cases caught, 0 false positives across 205 replies.

Loop/repeat fence: A pure function of the transcript that detects topics she over-raises (signal: she uses the word, he does not; no stoplist) and near-duplicates of her own replies (Jaccard 0.8). Allows one re-draft and arms the next turn on streamed lanes.

Behavioral attack battery: 208 attack turns, including Hinglish twins, run through the real compiled prompt. Predicate graders with severity tiers, a cash cap enforced before each call, a --dry mode that makes zero model calls, and gate-shaped exit codes.

Verified-human-intent for destructive LLM actions: userAskedToForget requires a delete-class word from the user in this turn or the 90s burst before it, in Latin or Devanagari script, before honoring the model's [forget] marker. claimsDeletion scrubs any reply line that claims a deletion happened. 44 checks.

Partial-forget episode integrity CTE: One SQL statement that unlinks the surviving raw log rows, inserts content-free provisional wake episodes so the consolidator re-segments them, then deletes the doomed episodes. Passed CI; codex branch only.

Shared-password server gate: An HMAC token derived from the access word(s). Off when the env var is unset; changing the word revokes every token. One client fetch wrapper; an eval asserts the protected and open route lists.

Ops event stream: A server ops event writer that never throws and records only counts, labels and decisions (never text), into meera_diag scope ops. Comes with the lesson that the path is not proven until a row has been read back.

Append-only consent ledger: A DPDP memory-consent table with no update path: the newest row is the current answer, and no column can hold anything a person said. Comes with a warm consent UI and a decline path that closes the memory write gate.

CharacterSheet / Relational Core split: Personas are typed fragment fields interpolated into a character-agnostic core. A byte-identity gate and a residue-leak ratchet pinned at 0 guard the split. A second persona (Kabir) passed 412/412 invariants with zero engine changes.

Single compiler with CORE/TAIL + budget gate: One prompt assembler for every lane. The safety floors sit in a byte-stable, never-truncated core (also the cache unit), and the volatile tail goes last. The budget gate throws instead of truncating silently.
Gated surface adapter: All surfaces (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord) route replies through one gatedReply call site. A static eval proves no ungated path exists.
context/ memory system: Decisions carry reversal conditions; measurements carry n, method and date; rejections are logged; a graph.json index is validated by scripts/context.mjs --check.
India market and regulatory sweep: 43-source sweep: Indian voice-agent pricing (₹3-65/min), TRAI outbound-AI rules, DPDP timelines, and companion-category ad policy.

html-portfolio [voice-cloning]: Vyakti Replica Lab: a consented self-replica control plane (identity/liveness, private evidence processing, provider-neutral VoiceGenome, Azure Personal Voice + self-hosted Chatterbox, blinded voice curriculum, watermark/C2PA provenance, erasure, spend ledger). It is fully built and passes its offline tests, but nothing has been measured live.

Atomic paid-provider spend ledger: Reserves conservative cost before provider I/O, marks a one-way begin, settles measured usage, and locks ambiguous outcomes as reconcile_required. Covers Foundry tokens, Speech audio seconds and Personal Voice profiles/characters under one grant ceiling.

Provider-neutral voice contract + registry: createVoice/getVoiceStatus/synthesizeStream/deleteVoice interface with fixed 24kHz s16le mono PCM output. The AI disclosure prefix is enforced by the contract, provider refs stay server-only, and fake providers are refused in production.

Azure Personal Voice adapter: Flow is consent resource, then profile, then pinned-base-model SSML synthesis to raw PCM. Operation-Ids are deterministic, deletion is idempotent, WAV input is byte-probed and each call is metered. Mock-tested only because Limited Access was never approved.
Strict WAV/PCM prober: Validates RIFF bounds and format fields, takes duration from the PCM itself, and rejects clipping, DC offset, silence and polyglot tails.
Azure Speech fast-transcription adapter: Metered fast-transcription client (api-version 2025-10-15) aimed at Hinglish, with content-free errors. Tested only against mocked responses.

Queue/lease DAG worker + Container Apps Job: Leased idempotent stages with create-only writes, rehash-on-write and content-free outcome codes. Runs as a scale-to-zero Container Apps Job with ClamAV and ffprobe.

HMAC admission broker in front of scale-to-zero GPU: A CPU broker validates body HMAC, nonce and timestamp before forwarding to a private GPU app, so random traffic cannot wake paid GPU capacity. Images are pinned by digest and Bicep is included.

Voice-evidence GPU service: Runs diarization, two-speaker separation, dual enhancement candidates and two speaker-embedding families. HMAC-authenticated in both directions, with models baked into the image.

Blinded Bradley-Terry active preference curriculum: Picks pairs by Fisher information plus an uncertainty term, applies a repeat penalty, rotates prompts through a deck, and uses a conservative convergence rule (18+ judgments, 6 prompt families).

Held-out qualification gate with Wilson bound: Uses a preregistered 6-prompt x 2-seed holdout with counterbalanced sides. A pass needs a rate of at least 0.75 and a Wilson lower bound above 0.5, and a pass can never auto-promote.

Blinded paired candidate promotion gate: A candidate must improve its target layer, stay non-inferior on the other layers, have zero critical safety failures, keep false memories bounded, and commit to its exact artifact, dataset and baseline.

Leakage-safe feedback dataset compiler + per-layer turn feedback: Builds immutable whole-conversation splits from latest revisions only and forces unsafe sessions into holdout. Feedback is graded separately per layer, and owner corrections are envelope-encrypted and stored as evidence rather than applied as prompt mutations.

Cited claim extraction via Azure Foundry strict output: Masks identifiers, calls Foundry with strict structured output, then re-validates the citations independently. Results are only proposals for review.

Erasure state machine with leased reconciler: Revokes the voice first, then deletes provider copies, source objects and derived models. A leased reconciler retries with exponential backoff and never reaches a terminal give-up state.

Revocation-aware streaming delivery fence + audio protection: Before releasing each signed 240 ms PCM segment, the active capability is checked again. Audio is protected with AudioSeal and C2PA, signed by a non-exportable Key Vault key.

Azure grant allocation plan and model acceptance rule: A $1,829 capped plan inside the $2k grant, with coverage traps (Direct-from-Azure only, no Professional Custom Neural Voice), alert ladder, tagging and expiry discipline, and a rule that a model must win the owned eval set.

Open voice-model landscape with licence verdicts: Sorts open voice models into adopt (VoxCPM2, MOSS-TTS, ZONOS2, OmniVoice, Chatterbox, Qwen3-ASR), route-first, and benchmark-only or reject on licence grounds.
